THE MORBI ARCHITECTURAL MANIFESTO

Natural marble is porous, fragile, and strip-mined. In Morbi, Gujarat, we compress pure Rajasthan feldspar, Kutch ball clay, and crystalline quartz under 44,000 tons of force and fuse them at 1,220°C—creating monolithic sintered stone that nature takes ten million years to form, perfected in 54 minutes.
